acceptance_criteria: Every proposed V1 field is traced to frozen authority or marked unresolved.
MigrationRunner compatibility is checked without changing runtime behavior.
A clear go/no-go recommendation for B1-2 implementation is produced.

baseline.sequencing: B1-1M topology decision precedes B1-2 schema implementation.

invariants: Configuration, inventory and alignment remain separate.
Evidence identity is not operational identity.
No secrets or raw vendor evidence enter artifacts.
report.merge_gate: PO review required; no B1-2 schema merge until B1-1M topology is accepted.
report.objective: Audit B1-2 Flyway V1 readiness against the frozen C1 contract and prepare only contract-safe scaffolding; stop with a concrete readiness report if topology inputs remain unresolved.
output_contract: Readiness report or contract-safe minimal patch

recommended_reasoning.reason: Bounded contract readiness audit with an explicit stop condition.

requirements: Read the cold-start files in order and use the existing graphify graph first.
Treat C1 and other frozen contracts as authority.
Do not implement speculative schema while B1-1M is unresolved.
risks: Parallel topology work may change service ownership.
Schema implementation before topology freeze can create migration debt.
validation_plan: Targeted schema/architecture tests if files change.
No real environment or device validation.
